about: Content that is deliberately not generated into ordinary worlds, with why. The census (scripts/activation-census.ts) marks anything listed here as intentional dormancy; anything it lists that is not here is unaccounted for. Reasons name what would have to be true for it to be activated.

paintings.ruins-installation-bridge: Mathematical Age scale (doc/architecture/activation/arcology.md): held for the arcology expedition; not an Aenean or generic ruin
paintings.campfire: a night camp in the wild; the word 'camp' also names towns' camps by day (test/scenery-kinds.test.ts pins them), so it needs a night-only selection
paintings.meadow-lane: the field kinds' lists are picked by hash: adding to them repaints every town's fields (M20's reference); wait for a batch the owner approves
paintings.city-market: needs a city-only selection: it shares the market/harbour/city kinds with towns, and adding to those lists repaints every town (test/scenery-kinds.test.ts pins them)

paintings.infinite-library: the owner's painting of exactly the Infinite Library; `places.infinite_library_threshold` still names an old master's ('library'), pinned by test/page-paintings.test.ts: a one-line swap for the owner to approve
paintings.house-of-doors-ice-portal: the planes of ice and lightning are not in the world yet (doc/paintings/commission-list.md: painted, not yet in the world)
paintings.house-of-doors-lightning-portal: the planes of ice and lightning are not in the world yet (doc/paintings/commission-list.md: painted, not yet in the world)
paintings.undercroft: a lit undercroft; the first hour's undercrofts are painted unlit (the owner, 10 November), so choosing it wants a selection by state (request R11)
paintings.ecumenopolis: a planet-wide terraced city seen from a balcony; the Numbered House's Terrace of Tiers now has the citadel built into its cliff (scene-ruins-citadel), and no other place is a view over a city of that size (it was the Terrace's stand-in until then)
paintings.secret-passage: a candle-lit vaulted passage with steps; no place is named a secret or hidden passage (a hidden way is a Passage, and only places are painted), so no kind has a word a place carries; a room that is one wants an authored binding (`places`) when its author writes it
paintings.overlook-city: the file assets/bg/overlook-city.png is byte-identical to secret-passage.png (it shows that vaulted passage, not a city seen from a height): imported as it came and left unmapped until the owner sends the city view
paintings.auditorium: an empty candlelit concert stage with a velvet auditorium; no generated or authored place is a concert hall (the Stone-Singers' hall is a hall of figures in rock, the Wet Stage a playhouse), so no kind word is carried
paintings.fortune-teller: a fortune-teller's table with crystal and cards; the circus has a fortune-teller (Nance, a person) but no place of hers, and no generated place is a fortune-teller's room
paintings.salon: (the owner's scene-salon, not the old master filed as a place) a gentleman's salon (fire, bust, telescope, globe); the only rooms called by its kind are 'parlours', which are as often a cottage's front room as a salon, so a kind on that word would hang it arbitrarily
paintings.vintner: a vintner's arbour above ground, with a press and a tasting table; the only wine rooms authored are cellars (the cellar kind, below ground), and no place is a vintner's or a wine-shop
paintings.shipwright: an open shed with a boat's ribs on the slip; the town's waterside yard is the 'wright's yard' (the woodwork kind) and its boat-sheds are pinned by test/scenery-kinds.test.ts, so a shipyard needs a place that says so
paintings.floating-isle-overlook: a floating island seen from a cliff over cloud; no place is a viewpoint on one (Cloudgate in the Grand Tour is the island itself, painted by scene-floating-city)
paintings.ruins-bridge: a stone bridge over a glass-roofed hall of tiers; the Numbered House's Bridge of Weights is bronze plate on chains (scene-ruins-arcology holds its ends), so no authored room is this one; for a second arcology or a stone span
paintings.ruins-hall: a long colonnaded gallery on the Great Void; the House has no room that is that corridor (the Terrace's gallery to the rim is a way, not a place); the rim holds scene-ruins-terrace
paintings.ruins-elevator: the whole ruined spire and viaduct seen from a distance; the House's lift is a cage in a shaft (its stop is scene-ruins-elevator-station), and no place is a view of a tower from afar
paintings.ruins-elevator-base: the foot of a vast cabled tower, outdoors; the House's lift stands inside the House, so no authored room is a tower's outdoor base
